captions.detailed: A 3D model of a super-telephoto camera lens featuring a long cylindrical barrel, a wide black front lens hood, and a dark rear mount cap. A grey rotating tripod collar with a flat mounting foot is positioned near the center of the light-grey main barrel. The front focus ring and the tripod collar are designed to rotate continuously around the main longitudinal axis of the lens.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a super-telephoto lens with a long barrel, a wide front focus ring/hood, and a rotating tripod collar with a mounting foot. Use a light grey material for the main barrel, black for the front hood and rear mount, and dark grey for the tripod collar.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens body using a series of cylinders representing the main barrel, a flared front hood, and a rear mount cap. Create the focus ring and the tripod collar as separate coaxial cylinders, with the tripod collar including an attached rectangular block for the mounting foot. Define continuous rotational joints (articulations) along the central Z-axis to allow both the front ring and the tripod collar to rotate freely around the main barrel.
